sanskrit: rujaś ca mā venaś ca mā hāsiṣṭām urvaś ca mā camasaś ca mā hāsiṣṭāṃ vimokaś ca mārdrapaviś ca mā hāsiṣṭām ārdradānuś ca mā mātariśvā ca mā hāsiṣṭāṃ mūrdhā ca mā vidharmā ca mā hāsiṣṭāṃ dhartā ca mā dharuṇaś ca mā hāsiṣṭāṃ mṛdhaś ca mā vaimṛdhaś ca mā hāsiṣṭām ||
english: May Ruja and Vena not abandon me; may Urva and Camasa not abandon me; may Vimoka and Ārdrapavi not abandon me; may Ārdradānu and Mātariśvan not abandon me; may Mūrdhā and Vidharma not abandon me; may Dhartā and Dharuṇa not abandon me; may Mṛdha and Vaimṛdha not abandon me.

sanskrit: bṛhaspatir ma ātmā nṛmaṇā nāma | hṛdayājarasaṃ mā mā hāsīr asaṃtāpaṃ me hṛdayam astu | urvī gavyūtiḥ samudro asmi vidharmaṇā | nābhir ahaṃ rayīṇāṃ nābhir ahaṃ samānānāṃ bhūyāsam ||
english: Bṛhaspati is my self; "Nṛmaṇā" is my name. O ageless Heart, do not abandon me; let my heart be free of distress. I am the wide, cow-rich pasture, I am the ocean, by the power of cosmic ordering. May I be the navel of riches, may I be the navel of my companions.

sanskrit: svāsad asi sūṣā amṛtā martyeṣv ā | mā mā prāṇo 'vahāya parā gān mā māpāno 'vahāya parā gāt | sūryo māhnaḥ pātv agniḥ pṛthivyā vāyur antarikṣād yamo manuṣyebhyaḥ sarasvatī pārthivebhyaḥ | prāṇāpānau mā mā hāsiṣṭaṃ mā jane pra meṣi | svasty adyoṣaso doṣasaś ca sarvā āpaḥ sarvagaṇo aśīya ||
english: You are the auspicious seat, the bright dawn, the immortal one come among mortals. May the in-breath not go forth and away from me, may the out-breath not go forth and away from me. May Sūrya protect me by day, Agni from the earth, Vāyu from the atmosphere, Yama from among men, Sarasvatī from the earthly realm. May in-breath and out-breath not abandon me; may I not pass away among people. May there be well-being today at dawn and at dusk; may I partake of all waters and of every assembly.

sanskrit: subhūr asi raśmir asy āyurdhā asy āyur mayi dhehi | (subhūr asi raśmir) asi varcodhā asi varco mayi dhehi ||
english: You are Subhū, you are a ray of light, you are the giver of life-span — place life-span in me. You are Subhū, you are a ray of light, you are the giver of vital-lustre — place vital-lustre in me.

sanskrit: subhūr asi raśmir asi tejodhā asi tejo mayi dhehi ||
english: You are Subhū, you are a ray of light, you are the giver of brilliance — place brilliance in me.

sanskrit: sūryo me varcodhā varco dadhātv indriyam asīndriyaṃ mayi dhehi varco asi varco mayi dhehi ||
english: May Sūrya, the giver of vital-lustre, place vital-lustre in me. You are vital-power — place vital-power in me. You are vital-lustre — place vital-lustre in me.

sanskrit: śakvarī stha paśavo mopa stheṣur mitrāvaruṇā me prāṇāpānāv agnir me dakṣaṃ dadhātu ||
english: You are the Śakvarī (mighty verses); may the cattle not be away from me. May Mitra and Varuṇa be my in-breath and out-breath; may Agni place energy in me.
